title: Linux rm Command: File Removing
overview: Command-line practice: Linux rm Command: File Removing

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: Practice Linux rm Command: File Removing. Use the prepared private Linux environment. Explanations and checks here are locally authored from the linked public requirements.
sections.content_vi: Thực hành Lệnh rm: xóa tệp. Dùng terminal Linux riêng của bài. Hướng dẫn và bộ kiểm tra local được biên soạn lại theo yêu cầu công khai đã liên kết.

sections.title: Navigating to the Project Directory
sections.content:
Enter the project directory; inspect location and entries.

```bash
cd /home/labex/project
pwd
ls
```

```bash

pwd
ls
```

sections.title: Removing a Single File
sections.content:
Remove old_report.txt. Deletion does not use a trash folder.

```bash
rm old_report.txt
```
sections.content_vi:
Xóa old_report.txt; lệnh không chuyển vào thùng rác.

```bash
rm old_report.txt
```

sections.title: Removing Multiple Files
sections.content:
Remove file1.tmp, file2.tmp and file3.tmp.

```bash
rm file1.tmp file2.tmp file3.tmp
```
sections.content_vi:
Xóa file1.tmp, file2.tmp và file3.tmp.

```bash
rm file1.tmp file2.tmp file3.tmp
```

sections.title: Removing a Directory
sections.content:
Use recursive removal on old_projects after inspecting it.

```bash
ls old_projects
rm -r old_projects
```
sections.content_vi:
Xem old_projects rồi xóa đệ quy thư mục đó.

```bash
ls old_projects
rm -r old_projects
```

sections.title: Using the -i Option for Interactive Removal
sections.content:
Run rm -i important_file.txt and confirm with y.

```bash
rm -i important_file.txt
```
sections.content_vi:
Chạy rm -i important_file.txt rồi xác nhận y.

```bash
rm -i important_file.txt
```
